excerpt: The Business Benefits of Global Recruitment: Why Expanding Your Talent Pool Matters Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Economic booms bring excitement and optimism for businesses, often leading to rapid hiring and ambitious expansion plans. But in the past, it has been seen that overexpansion during these periods can create long-term risks—such as layoffs, wasted resources, and damage to the employer brand—when the market inevitably shifts. Sustainable hiring is the key to building a resilient, future-ready workforce that thrives in both good times and challenging ones. What Is Sustainable
